name: @termina/cli-proxy
description: CLI diagnostics for proxy environment inspection and route explanation

scripts.build: npm exec -- node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm exec -- node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const candidates=['dist/cli.js','dist/cli-proxy/src/cli.js'];let target='';for(const candidate of candidates){if(fs.existsSync(candidate)){target=candidate;break;}}if(!target){throw new Error('cli.js not found in expected output paths');}if(target!=='dist/cli.js'){fs.copyFileSync(target,'dist/cli.js');}fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js',0o755);"
scripts.test: npm exec -- node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npm exec -- node --test dist/**/*.test.js && npm exec -- node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})"
